description: This file implements the SocketTracker class, which manages and logs socket states and activities within the starboard namespace. It tracks socket creation, connection, binding, acceptance, data transmission, resolution, and lifecycle events, providing functions for state queries and logging.

classes.name: SocketTracker
classes.description: Manages socket lifecycle, state, and activity tracking, providing logging and status query functionalities.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SocketTracker.

methods.name: OnCreate
methods.description: Records the creation of a socket with its address type and protocol.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Updates socket state to connected with remote address.

methods.name: OnBind
methods.description: Records local address binding for a socket.

methods.name: OnAccept
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a new socket connection, creating a record for the accepted socket.

methods.name: OnReceiveFrom
methods.description: Updates last activity time and remote address upon receiving data.

methods.name: OnSendTo
methods.description: Updates last activity time and remote address upon sending data.

methods.name: IsSocketTracked
methods.description: Checks if a socket is currently tracked.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of a socket.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a socket.

methods.name: OnAddWaiter
methods.description: Associates a waiter with a socket.

methods.name: OnRemoveWaiter
methods.description: Removes the waiter association from a socket.

methods.name: LogTrackedSockets
methods.description: Logs details of all tracked sockets.

methods.name: ConvertToString_Locked
methods.description: Converts a socket address or record to a string for logging.

methods.name: ComputeTimeIdle
methods.description: Calculates the idle time of a socket based on last activity.
